chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Washing the head with the Qitm plant every Friday is a protection from leprosy and madness."

key_terms.بِالْخِطْمِيِّ: With the Qitm plant (a specific medicinal plant/lichen)

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of washing the head with Qitm on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the Friday ritual of washing the head with Qitm (a medicinal lichen) to protection from leprosy and madness, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating physical hygiene with spiritual well-being. This practice underscores the belief that specific acts of worship on auspicious days like Friday carry both tangible health benefits and spiritual safeguards.
